reason: A theme customization studio for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, providing visual theme creation, image-based color extraction, local browser injection, and skin package export.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供可视化换肤、图片取色、主题注入和皮肤包导出功能。
summaries.en: A visual skinning studio for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with image-based color extraction, local theme injection, and skin package export.

capabilities: Generates and applies visual themes to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI
Injects CSS and theme menu elements through bookmarklet or local CDP
Creates and exports theme definitions and skin packages
Reads local browser debugging state to locate the target page
